description: Plug-and-play, dependency-free web command center for DGX Spark fleets (and any GPU boxes): live per-node GPU/CPU/mem/temps/power, optional RouterOS switch monitoring, and per-model decode/prefill/TTFT/KV cards. Point it at your own hardware.
